# (Later releases leave that input empty for categorized auto-generated notes.)

Homeroom is a local-first student planner for timetable, homework, exams and
attendance — no accounts, no cloud. Your data stays on the device, with
optional encrypted peer-to-peer sync over your local network.

## Features

- **Today** — greeting, attendance ring, today's classes, due homework and upcoming exams
- **Timetable** — week grid with now-line, periods, rooms
- **Homework / Exams** — filters, groups (open/done, upcoming/graded), per-item reminders
- **Attendance** — per-subject stats, skip budget, month calendar, mark any day
- **Semesters** — each semester keeps its own data, sample week loader, start-fresh wipe
- **Reminders** — in-app toasts plus OS notifications
- **Sync** — end-to-end encrypted LAN sync: one device taps *Generate QR code*, the other taps *Scan QR code* to pair and sync automatically
- **Backup** — export/import the whole database as JSON

## Downloads

- **Linux:** `Homeroom-*-amd64.AppImage` (needs libfuse2), or the `.tar.gz` (extract and run `./Homeroom/AppRun`, no FUSE needed)
- **Android (arm64):** `app-universal-release.apk` (signed)
